Name: Config Backup
Author: LilietBorodina
Description:
Re-uploading without the .exe file which was apparently being suspicious. My condolences to the Windows users.

[url=https://github.com/LilietB/Config-Backup]GitHub repository with a readme and usage example[/url]

The short explanation is that you put the configBackup.ps1 file in your Mods folder or a subfolder further down, and it will create a ConfigBackup folder with copies of all config.json files it has found, including the folder structure, so you can copypate the entire contents of ConfigBackup back out and restore the files.

In addition to simply preserving and restoring your own configs, this can be used to give your configuration to another player (for example, for multiplayer) or copy it to another machine.
